name: Financial Model Variant 8
task:
Please complete the following four-stage financial analysis task.

=== Stage 1: Cash Flow Projection ===
A marketing campaign: $30,000 upfront. Expected new customers: 500 at $200 lifetime value each. 3-year projection.

=== Stage 2: NPV Calculation ===
Calculate NPV at 8% and 12% discount rates.

=== Stage 3: Sensitivity Analysis ===
Vary key parameters by ±20%.

=== Stage 4: Recommendation ===
Should the investment proceed?
